situations.headline: Bubs Australia wins permanent FDA authorisation for US infant formula imports

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Bubs Australia wins permanent FDA authorisation for US infant formula imports (interest 6, risk 3)

thesis.text: Bubs' permanent FDA authorisation removes a key regulatory overhang on its US market access, converting prior conditional/temporary approval into a durable structural advantage as one of few non-US infant formula suppliers permitted long-term entry [asx:0ee282389225a52f3d7b4907c6d25c26 p.1]. The near-term catalyst is management's investor webinar clarifying commercial monetisation, including potential private label expansion [asx:0ee282389225a52f3d7b4907c6d25c26 p.1]. Watch for follow-on announcements quantifying revenue/volume impact from expanded US distribution.
